integrity: The argument classifies dual sets using a cycle restriction and a complete 34-pair prism certificate; unrelated previously established single-cycle results are explicitly credited. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite simple Cartesian products C_n square K_m with n >=5, m >=1. No general graph-product classification or claim about n=3,4. Historical priority provisional; the finite verifier complements a parameter-uniform proof.
title: Dual mutual-visibility colorings of cycle–clique Cartesian products
